question: Callback function kya hota hai?
options: Ek function jo doosre function ko pass kiya jaata hai aur baad mein call hota hai
Ek function jo hamesha return karta hai
Ek function jo sirf ek baar chalta hai
explanation: Callback: function as argument pass karo, woh kaam khatam hone pe call hota hai. setTimeout, event listeners, Node.js APIs sab callbacks use karte hain.

question: Promise ke kitne states hote hain?
explanation: Promise teen states mein hota hai: Pending (initial), Fulfilled (resolve — kaam hua), Rejected (reject — error aaya). Settled = fulfilled ya rejected.

question: Promise mein .then() aur .catch() ka kya kaam hai?
options: .then() success handle, .catch() error handle karta hai
explanation: .then() resolved promise pe chalta hai — jo value mili use handle karo. .catch() rejected promise pe — error handle karo. Clean chain banti hai.

question: Promise.all() kya karta hai?
options: Saare promises ka wait karta hai — sab成功 toh array, ek bhi fail toh error
Sirf pehla promise resolve karta hai
Ek ek karke promises chalata hai
explanation: Promise.all() array of promises leta hai. Sab resolve honge toh results array milega. Ek bhi reject hua toh turant error — baaki promises cancel nahi hote but ignored hain.

question: Callback hell kya hota hai?
options: Callbacks ke andar callbacks ka deeply nested structure
explanation: Callback hell: nested callbacks itne deep ho jaate hain ki code unreadable ho jaata hai (pyramid of doom). Promises aur async/await iska solution hain.
